name: week
title: Fleet this week
subtitle: What needs a decision before Monday's workshop meeting

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Overdue services, expiring renewals, faults with no job, quiet work orders, stale odometers and odd fuel fills.
sections.sql: select vehicle, reason, detail from v_attention order by reason, vehicle

sections.title: Service due
sections.sql: select vehicle, service, state, km_left as "km left", due_on as "due on", booked from v_service_due where state <> 'ok' order by state desc, vehicle

sections.title: Renewals
sections.note: WoF, CoF, rego, RUC and AU inspections that have expired or fall due soon.
sections.sql: select vehicle, upper(kind) as renewal, due_on as "due on", km_left as "km left", state from v_renewals where state <> 'ok' order by state, vehicle

sections.title: Open work orders
sections.sql: select number, vehicle, coalesce(vendor, 'in house') as workshop, status, age_days as "days open", quiet_days as "days quiet" from v_work_orders where status in ('open','in_progress','on_hold') order by age_days desc

name: costs
title: Running costs, last 12 months
subtitle: Fuel, workshop and other costs per vehicle against distance travelled

sections.title: Cost per km
sections.note: Each currency is shown on its own line. Cents per km is total cost over distance recorded in the year.
sections.sql: select vehicle, depot, currency, round(fuel_cents/100.0,2) as fuel, round(workshop_cents/100.0,2) as workshop, round(other_cents/100.0,2) as other, round(total_cents/100.0,2) as total, km, cents_per_km as "cents per km" from v_costs order by currency, cents_per_km desc nulls last

sections.title: Replacement signals
sections.note: Signals, not a verdict: age 8+ years, 300,000+ km, 12-month workshop spend over 15% of purchase price, four or more jobs in a year.
sections.sql: select vehicle, make_model as vehicle_model, age_years as "age", odometer, round(workshop_12m_cents/100.0,2) as "workshop 12m", signals from v_replace_plan order by signals desc, workshop_12m_cents desc
